AppRoleAssignments.Reason: Reads Intune managed devices including freeStorageSpaceInBytes and totalStorageSpaceInBytes to find devices below the low disk space threshold
Sends the report email via Send-RjRbReportEmail when email delivery is selected
Reads /organization for the tenant name used in the report file names, the email subject and the email footer; without it the runbook falls back to 'Unknown Tenant'

ManualPermissions: Azure Storage Account: 'Storage Account Contributor' role for the Automation Account's managed identity on the target storage account - the upload retrieves the account keys via listKeys (only required for the download link options)
